# Search and vector indexes — concept pack

> Full-text/search indexes (MongoDB text indexes and Atlas Search indexes, Convex search indexes, Postgres tsvector/pg_trgm/GIN) and approximate-nearest-neighbour vector indexes (pgvector HNSW and IVFFlat, DiskANN, Atlas Vector Search, Convex and Turso/libSQL vector indexes): how they differ from B-tree indexes, their parameters, and their limits. Child pack of Indexing.
